title: Admit creatures into an active combat instance (mid-combat summons and arrivals)
description: Discovered while designing eshyra-82uk (2026-10-08). start_encounter only opens a NEW combat instance, and only one instance may be active per campaign (turnAuditor). Nothing adds a combatant to the running instance, so a summon cast mid-combat (Conjure Animals in round 3, Animate Dead, Find Familiar recall from its pocket) or a reinforcement cannot become a combatant, and start_effect's actors entries need an existing combatantId. eshyra-82uk factors an internal seam that projects a campaign actor into the active instance (used by the pocket recall). This bead owns the model-facing capability: a tool (e.g. join_combat { actors: [...] , encounter creatures? }) with the same admission rules as start_encounter (absent/bonded/pocketed refusals, 0-HP rules, lifecycle carry-over), instance-only creatures as well as campaign actors, and the turn/round consequences (initiative is model-narrated; begin_turn boundaries). Design the instance-only case: combatant ids, side, and start_effect linking afterwards.
design:
DESIGN (Claude Captain, 2026-10-08)

Tool join_combat { creatures?: [...], actors?: [...] } admits creatures into the campaign's ACTIVE combat instance. At least one entry is required. It is refused when no instance is active ("start_encounter opens one"). One transaction: every entry is validated before any row is written, and a refusal leaves state unchanged.

- creatures[] (instance-only, identity encounter_instance): { rulesRef (required, must resolve as a creature record), count? (int >= 1, default 1), side (REQUIRED), faction?, displayLabel?, placement? }. HP/AC/heads come from the creature record exactly as start_encounter's template creatures do (readCreatureHp, readCreatureAc, initialHeadCount; admitCombatantLifecycle). Row id: `${instance}-${slug(rulesRef)}-${n}` with n the next free ordinal for that prefix (existence check loop, as the recall's suffix loop). Label: displayLabel ?? record name, numbered " 1".." n" when count > 1.
- actors[] (persistent campaign actors): same schema and admission rules as start_encounter actors (reuse admitCampaignActorToInstance; refuse state.combatLifecycle as start_encounter does) with `side` REQUIRED. Extra rules: refuse an actor that already has a non-absent row in this instance (it is already in this combat, alive, dead or otherwise); an actor whose only rows here are absent is admitted under the existing absent rules (new manifestation with hpCurrent > 0; bonded absent refused; pocketed refused -> recall). Row id via ONE shared helper used by both join_combat and recallPocketedCampaignActor: `${instance}-${slug(actorId)}`, else -2, -3...
- Initiative and turn order stay model-narrated (actionEconomy.ts); a joiner's turn budget row is created by its first begin_turn. The tool description says so, and says a summon's effect is recorded afterwards with start_effect using the returned combatant ids (actors[].combatantId; campaignActorId for durable summons).
- Result: { combatInstance, joined: [combatant views of the new rows] }.
- protocol.ts (system prompt) mentions start_encounter for starting combat; add one line that creatures arriving mid-combat (summons, reinforcements, a recalled familiar is automatic) join with join_combat.
Not in scope: authored encounter template reinforcement waves (encounterId), placement/geometry.
